seed_memory.title: Escalation to a person
seed_memory.content: When two recorded policies disagree, or a request needs a licensed professional, stop and escalate to the workspace approver. Never pick one yourself.

seed_memory.title: What needs approval
seed_memory.content: Reads and drafts run automatically. Sending email, changing CRM records and anything that spends money waits in the approval queue for a named approver.
